tagline: Finance and operations leaders for Canada's mid-market companies
intro: We recruit controllers, FP&A leads, CFOs and operations directors for privately held and investor-backed companies across Canada. A partner runs every search from the first brief to the signed offer.
audience: Mid-market companies across Ontario, Quebec, the Prairies and British Columbia, hiring finance and operations people at manager, director and executive level.
pricing_note: A percentage of first-year base salary, invoiced when your hire starts. CFO and VP searches run on retained terms, with the retainer credited against the final fee.

services.title: Retained executive search
services.description: For CFO, VP finance and COO seats. A defined search with a written brief, a researched shortlist, full referencing and a partner at every debrief.

services.title: Contingent finance hiring
services.description: Controllers, assistant controllers and accounting managers. You pay only when someone you chose accepts your offer and starts.

services.title: Interim and contract leaders
services.description: A controller or finance lead to cover a year-end close, a system change or a leave, on a fixed term while you hire for the permanent seat.

services.title: Salary and structure advice
services.description: Before you post a role: what the seat pays in your region, who it should report to and what experienced candidates will expect from you.

process.title: Brief the seat
process.description: We meet the hiring manager, map who the role reports to and agree the scorecard, the salary band and the timeline before we approach anyone.

process.title: Search and assess
process.description: We approach people directly, interview each one on technical depth and fit with your team, and check references before you meet them.

process.title: Shortlist and close
process.description: You see a short list with our notes on each person. We arrange interviews, manage the offer and stay in touch through the first months.

proof.text: Our new controller closed the first quarter without a gap.
A partner ran the search from brief to signed offer.
Clear shortlists, and every reference checked.
